title: Aspirin / extended-release dipyridamole (Aggrenox)
mechanism: Aspirin COX-1 inhibition plus dipyridamole adenosine-uptake and PDE inhibition

uses.agent: Aspirin 25 mg / ER-dipyridamole 200 mg — noncardioembolic stroke/TIA (long-term SAPT)
uses.doseText: 1 capsule BID (morning and evening), with or without food
notes: Antiplatelet preferred over anticoagulation (AHA 2026 and Kleindorfer 2021: COR 1, A)
Choose agent on risk profile, cost, tolerance (AHA 2026: COR 1, C-EO)
evidenceNote: Kleindorfer 2021: COR 1, LOE A (aspirin 50–325 mg, clopidogrel 75 mg, or aspirin 25 mg/ER-dipyridamole 200 mg BID)

uses.doseText: 1 capsule at bedtime + low-dose aspirin in the morning; return to BID within about 1 week
notes: No outcome data for this regimen (label)

renalHepatic: Avoid in severe hepatic or severe renal insufficiency (GFR <10) (label)

holdBeforeProcedure: Not stated in label — local policy
thrombolysisRule: Prior SAPT/DAPT doesn't exclude IVT — give if otherwise eligible (AHA 2026 §4.6.1 Rec 9: COR 1, B-NR); sICH +0.9% SAPT / +1.2% DAPT absolute (class-level statement; agent not named)

reversal.agent: Platelet transfusion — ICH without planned surgery
notes: NCS: against, regardless of agent, platelet-function result, volume or exam
evidenceNote: AHA ICH 2022: COR 3: Harm, LOE B-R (aspirin)

reversal.doseText: 1 single-donor apheresis unit; platelet-function testing first if available
notes: Repeat only if platelet function stays abnormal (NCS)
Don't transfuse if platelet function is normal or documented resistance (NCS strong)
evidenceNote: NCS 2016: conditional, moderate quality (aspirin or ADP inhibitor)

notes: Can be combined with platelet transfusion before surgery (NCS)
evidenceNote: AHA ICH 2022: COR 2b, LOE C-LD (effectiveness uncertain)

monitoring: Headache (most common early reason to stop) (label)
interactions: Dipyridamole raises adenosine levels — hold before adenosine/dipyridamole stress testing (label)
pearls: Not interchangeable with separate aspirin and dipyridamole tablets (label)
Contraindicated with NSAID allergy or the asthma/rhinitis/nasal polyp syndrome (label)
Never combine with clopidogrel: triple antiplatelet therapy is harmful (AHA 2026: COR 3: Harm, B-R)
